text:
Situation: Cefepime 2 g injection at Corvale East has 95 vials on hand, providing 5.5 days of supply at current use. Corvale General holds 321 vials (20.2 days) and 303 vials (18.9 days). Corvale Lakeside holds 45 vials (17.6 days). Corvale East also holds 282 vials of cefepime hydrochloride 2 g (20.8 days). FDA's drug shortage list does not include cefepime as of 2026-10-21.

Why (FDA record): FDA lists cefepime as "To Be Discontinued" with no date provided. FDA's drug shortage list does not include cefepime as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Internal transfer from Corvale General is the fastest way to extend Corvale East coverage to 11 days while Corvale General retains two weeks of supply. Apotex Corp., B. Braun Medical Inc., and Baxter Healthcare Corporation are not on FDA's shortage list today; their labels name no plant we could place.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 99 vials of 2 g from Corvale General to Corvale East — requires pharmacy director approval of transfer request.
2. Transfer 9 vials of 2 g from Corvale Lakeside to Corvale East — requires pharmacy director approval of transfer request.
3. Evaluate Apotex Corp. purchase if transfers are insufficient — requires buyer approval.

Not recommended: Purchases from B. Braun Medical Inc. or Baxter Healthcare Corporation at this time; no plant can be placed from their labels.
